pages.text: This module tweaks various gameplay elements.

pages.title: Armor Stands
pages.text: Armor stands now have arms and can hold weapons.

pages.title: Axes Break Leaves
pages.text: Axes break leaves as effectively as shears.

pages.title: Stone Crafting
pages.text: Craft stone tools from any stone type.

pages.title: Baby Zombies Burn
pages.text: Baby zombies burn in sunlight just like adults.

pages.title: Torches as Fuel
pages.text: Torches can smelt 2 items each in a furnace.

pages.title: Shearing Chickens
pages.text: Chickens can be sheared for feathers.

pages.title: Chicken Shedding
pages.text: Chickens periodically shed feathers like eggs.

pages.title: Clay Conversion
pages.text: Clay blocks can be crafted back into clay balls.

pages.title: Dirt to Path
pages.text: Right-clicking dirt with a shovel creates a path.

pages.title: Dye Any Wool
pages.text: You can dye colored wool directly.

pages.title: Smart Endermen
pages.text: On Hard difficulty, you cannot hide under 2-block ceilings.

pages.title: Glass Shards
pages.text: 4 glass shards craft into a glass block.

pages.title: Hoe Harvesting
pages.text: Better hoes clear more grass and plants at once.

pages.title: Knock Knock
pages.text: Knocking on doors plays a louder sound.

pages.title: Antique Atlas
pages.text: A handy book map allowing comfortable land navigation.

pages.title: Invisibility
pages.text: With invisibility active, mobs cannot detect you.

pages.title: Drop-down Ladders
pages.text: Ladders can be placed downwards from the top block.

pages.title: Fast Descent
pages.text: Looking down allows faster descent down ladders.

pages.title: Minecarts
pages.text: Chests and furnaces can be placed directly into minecarts.

pages.title: Pet the Dogs
pages.text: Pet your tamed dogs with Shift + right-click.

pages.title: Quick Armor Swap
pages.text: Shift + right-click armor stands to swap equipped gear.

pages.title: Crop Harvesting
pages.text: Better hoes harvest and replant larger crop areas.

pages.title: Double Doors
pages.text: Double doors open together automatically, even by villagers.

pages.title: Improved Sleep
pages.text: Night skips when all non-AFK players sleep. Players idle for two minutes count as AFK.

pages.title: Shave Snow
pages.text: Right-clicking snow with a shovel shaves off layers.

pages.title: Sign Editing
pages.text: Right-click a $(l:vainlla+/Decoration#signs)sign$() with an empty hand to edit it.

pages.title: Slabs to Blocks
pages.text: Slabs can be combined back into full blocks.

pages.title: Springy Slime
pages.text: Dropped items bounce off $(l:vainlla+/Automation#colored_slime)slime blocks$().

pages.title: Squid Inking
pages.text: When attacked, squids emit blinding ink clouds.

pages.title: Beacon Compass
pages.text: Shift + right-click to bind.$(br)Anvil + iron ingot to unbind.

pages.title: Wolf Armor
pages.text: Wolves have access to full armor tiers with equivalent defensive perks. Dispensers can equip armor onto them, and wolves can also carry storage chests.

pages.title: Wolf Armor
pages.text: The true alpha boss of the pack.
